columns: Each vector is represented by bit columns, e.g. a_00 through a_15; intermediate and output vectors use the same convention.
split_policy: Random independent input tuples; exact input tuples are unique across train/validation/test within each task.
limitations: This is a synthetic supervised dataset and provides equation-level ground truth, not evidence that a trained transformer internally uses the intended intermediates.
Vector-valued Boolean operations increase input-space size, but a model may still learn an equivalent shortcut.
Causal interventions on trained model activations are required to assess intermediate dependence.
Do not combine 2-hop and 3-hop examples without retaining the task and hop_depth fields.
